{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSResolver where

import System.IO
import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import System.Posix.Files
import System.Posix.Types
import System.Posix.Temp (mkstemp)
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Format
import Data.IORef
import Control.Exception
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Word
import Text.Printf

-- DNS Record types
data DNSRecord = DNSRecord
  { rrName   :: String
  , rrType   :: Word16
  , rrTTL    :: Word32
  , rrData   :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data ResolverConfig = ResolverConfig
  { rcUpstream    :: String
  , rcCacheDir    :: FilePath
  , rcAuditDir    :: FilePath
  , rcMaxRetries  :: Int
  , rcTimeoutMs   :: Int
  }

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , aeQuery     :: String
  , aeResult    :: Either String [DNSRecord]
  , aeClientIP  :: String
  }

-- Secure file creation mode
auditFileMode :: FileMode
auditFileMode = ownerReadMode `unionFileModes` ownerWriteMode

-- Generate audit log path with timestamp-based naming
auditLogPath :: ResolverConfig -> UTCTime -> FilePath
auditLogPath cfg ts = rcAuditDir cfg </> formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y%m%d" ts <.> "log"

-- Atomically write audit entry using temporary file
writeAuditEntry :: ResolverConfig -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
writeAuditEntry cfg entry = do
  let logPath = auditLogPath cfg (aeTimestamp entry)
  ensureAuditDir cfg
  atomicAppendAudit logPath (formatAuditEntry entry)

-- Ensure audit directory exists with proper permissions
ensureAuditDir :: ResolverConfig -> IO ()
ensureAuditDir cfg = do
  exists <- doesDirectoryExist (rcAuditDir cfg)
  if exists
    then return ()
    else createDirectoryIfMissing True (rcAuditDir cfg)

-- Format audit entry for logging
formatAuditEntry :: AuditEntry -> String
formatAuditEntry entry = printf "[%s] client=%s query=%s result=%s\n"
  (show $ aeTimestamp entry)
  (aeClientIP entry)
  (aeQuery entry)
  (show $ aeResult entry)

-- Core atomic append implementation
-- Uses a unique temporary file to ensure complete writes before appending
atomicAppendAudit :: FilePath -> String -> IO ()
atomicAppendAudit targetPath content = do
  let dir = takeDirectory targetPath
      template = dir </> ".audit_XXXXXX"
  -- Create unique temp file with mkstemp (secure, no race condition)
  -- mkstemp creates the file with 0600 permissions atomically.
  (stagingPath, h) <- mkstemp template
  hSetBuffering h LineBuffering
  hPutStr h content
  hFlush h
  hClose h
  -- Append staging content to target
  appendStagingToTarget stagingPath targetPath
  -- Clean up staging file
  removeIfExists stagingPath

-- Append staging file content to target log
appendStagingToTarget :: FilePath -> FilePath -> IO ()
appendStagingToTarget staging target = do
  content <- readFile staging
  -- Open target with exclusive permissions
  bracket (openFile target AppendMode) hClose $ \h -> do
    hSetBuffering h LineBuffering
    hPutStr h content
    hFlush h

-- Remove file if it exists
removeIfExists :: FilePath -> IO ()
removeIfExists path = removeFile path `catch` handleMissing
  where handleMissing :: IOError -> IO ()
        handleMissing _ = return ()

-- DNS resolution with audit logging
resolveDNS :: ResolverConfig -> String -> String -> IO (Either String [DNSRecord])
resolveDNS cfg clientIP query = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  result <- performLookup cfg query
  let entry = AuditEntry now query result clientIP
  writeAuditEntry cfg entry
  return result

-- Simulated DNS lookup
performLookup :: ResolverConfig -> String -> IO (Either String [DNSRecord])
performLookup cfg query = do
  -- In production, this would contact upstream resolver
  return $ Right [DNSRecord query 1 300 "93.184.216.34"]

-- Cache management with secure temp files
writeCacheEntry :: ResolverConfig -> DNSRecord -> IO ()
writeCacheEntry cfg record = do
  let cachePath = rcCacheDir cfg </> sanitizeFilename (rrName record)
  -- Use mkstemp for secure temporary file creation
  (tmpPath, h) <- mkstemp (cachePath ++ ".XXXXXX")
  hPutStr h (show record)
  hFlush h
  hClose h
  renameFile tmpPath cachePath

-- Sanitize filename to prevent path traversal
sanitizeFilename :: String -> String
sanitizeFilename = concatMap sanitizeChar
  where
    sanitizeChar '/'  = "_"
    sanitizeChar '\\' = "_"
    sanitizeChar '.'  = "_"
    sanitizeChar c    = [c]

-- Initialize resolver
initResolver :: ResolverConfig -> IO ()
initResolver cfg = do
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (rcCacheDir cfg)
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (rcAuditDir cfg)
  -- Set restrictive permissions on audit directory
  setFileMode (rcAuditDir cfg) (ownerReadMode `unionFileModes` ownerWriteMode `unionFileModes` ownerExecuteMode)
